name: hash_cracker
description: Attempt to crack a hash against a small built-in list of common passwords (educational/weak-password demonstration only, not a real cracking tool), or estimate how difficult a given hash algorithm is to crack in general.

action.description: crack: attempt one hash against the common-password list (requires explicit confirmation). crack_multiple: attempt several hashes at once. estimate_difficulty: general difficulty rating for a named hash algorithm, no actual cracking attempted.

hash.description: A single hash to attempt cracking. Required for action='crack'.

hashes.description: Multiple hashes to attempt cracking. Required for action='crack_multiple'.

hash_type.description: The hash algorithm used. Defaults to 'md5' if omitted.

confirm.description: Must be explicitly true to actually attempt cracking a single hash (action='crack'). The first call should omit this to get a confirmation prompt; only set true after the user explicitly confirms.
